title: Letter canvas
summary: The canvas of SIMAI Email Editor: a rendered letter in a frame that runs nothing, the width switch, the out-of-date and weight notes and sf-composition-overlay on top. The element knows no letter, no block manifest and no renderer: the host passes the HTML and the data about it, and hears what the person did.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

html.description: The rendered letter, the string the frame shows. Empty keeps the last good picture.

selected.description: The chosen block; empty means none is.

width.description: The width in use, by value; empty or unknown is the first of widths. The element changes it itself when the person presses a width.

stale.description: Says the picture is out of date; the picture stays.

accepts.description: The sf-sortable groups whose items may be dropped on the letter, separated by spaces (the overlay's accepts).

mark-attribute.description: The attribute that marks a block in the letter; its value is the item's id. A data- name.

box-attribute.description: The attribute that marks a block's box inside it: the box takes the tint and the overlay's line. Empty is the block itself. A data- name.

paper.description: A selector of the letter's paper inside the frame: it casts the shadow when the frame is wider than the letter. Otherwise the frame casts it.

overlay-target.description: The id of an sf-composition-overlay the host placed elsewhere on the page, outside a contained ancestor (simai/ui-source#58). Empty places one in the element's own markup.

widths.description: The widths offered, as sf-button-group takes them: {value, label, icon, icon-only, aria-label}. value is the letter's width; frame is the frame's width in pixels when it differs from value. Empty shows no switch and the frame fills the well.

weight.description: How heavy the letter's HTML is, {bytes, max} in kilobytes, when it comes near the clip size. Empty shows no note.

items.description: What the letter holds, for the overlay and for what counts as a block: {id, label, kind, parent, editable, rect}. A mark in the letter whose id is not here is not a block.

actions.description: The toolbar of the chosen block: up to 16 {id, label}, through the overlay's own check.

id.description: The block's id: what the events carry and what the mark holds.

label.description: Its name, in the overlay's frame and tree.

editable.description: Allows plain-string editing on the letter.

rect.description: {x, y, width, height} in frame coordinates, for a part with no element.

choice.const: A press in the frame or the tree dispatches sf-mail-canvas-select {ids, id}; the pointer sf-mail-canvas-hover {id}; a width button change {value, previous}; the overlay sf-mail-canvas-apply {action, scope, ids}, sf-mail-canvas-insert {parent, slot, index, item, from, mode}, sf-mail-canvas-move {ids, id, parent, position, slot} and sf-mail-canvas-edit {id, value, previous}; a loaded letter sf-mail-canvas-draw {}. The element changes no letter: the host does, and passes the HTML back.

select.summary: Choose a block as a press does; no id chooses none; refused unknown for a block not in items.

setWidth.summary: Switch the width as its button does; refused unknown for a width not offered, unchanged when it is in use.

returns.description: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason: unknown | unchanged}

reveal.summary: Bring a block into view on the canvas, the chosen one without an id; refused unknown, unchanged when it is already in view.

returns.description: {outcome: applied} or {outcome: refused, reason: unknown | unchanged}

refresh.summary: Measure the frame and update the overlay again, after a change nothing reports (a transform on an ancestor).

sf-mail-canvas-select.summary: This block was chosen: {ids, id}. An empty id is none.

sf-mail-canvas-hover.summary: The pointer is over this block: {id}. An empty id is none.

change.summary: The width in use is now this: {value, previous}.

sf-mail-canvas-apply.summary: This toolbar action was chosen for this block: {action, scope, ids}.

sf-mail-canvas-insert.summary: A block was asked for at this place: {parent, slot, index, item, from, mode}.

sf-mail-canvas-move.summary: Move this block to this place: {ids, id, parent, position, slot}.

sf-mail-canvas-edit.summary: This node's text now reads this: {id, value, previous}. Cancel to put the text back.

sf-mail-canvas-draw.summary: A new letter is in the frame, not yet measured.

untrusted_inputs: html (shown in a sandboxed frame with no scripts)
marks in html (a block only when items names it)

accessibility.focus: The width switch, then the overlay's tree. The frame and the letter's links take no tab stop. The frame and the layer are named in the page language.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-mail-canvas wherever a person sees and presses on a rendered letter in SIMAI Email Editor.
do_not: Do not give the frame scripts or a wider sandbox
Do not place the element's own overlay under an ancestor with contain: layout; pass overlay-target
Do not render or change the letter in the element; listen for its events and do it in the host
